bass.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and palm-muted double stops. The electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, emphasizing the downbeat with a low E and following with rapid octaves and chromatic passing tones. The drum kit maintains a tight groove with a crisp snare and a steady kick drum pattern that mirrors the bass guitar's rhythmic accents. Key of E minor. 105 BPM. 4/4 time signature. The mix features a dry, close-mic'd aesthetic with minimal reverb, highlighting the transient attack of the slap bass and the rhythmic precision of the guitar scratches.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap electric bass enters with syncopated E minor riff]
[clean electric guitar enters with percussive 16th-note scratches]
[drum kit enters with tight backbeat and ghost notes on snare]

drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop track at 85 BPM in the key of C minor. A Rhodes electric piano plays a four-bar progression of jazzy seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, saturated kick drum hitting on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp, layered snare on beats 2 and 4. A steady 16th-note closed hi-hat pattern includes occasional velocity variations and subtle swing. A warm, sub-heavy synth bass follows the root notes of the piano chords with a slight portamento between transitions. A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the arrangement. A melodic lead is provided by a sampled, filtered flute that plays short, pentatonic phrases with heavy reverb and delay.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss begins]
[Rhodes electric piano enters with tremolo chords]

[Main Section]
[saturated kick and snare enter]
[16th-note closed hi-hats]
[sub synth bass enters]
[filtered flute lead plays melodic phrases with delay]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades out]
[vinyl crackle lingers and fades]

vocals.tags: Funk and soul instrumental. The arrangement features a clean, rhythmic electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note muted strums and dominant 7th chords. A Fender Precision-style electric bass performs a melodic, walking line with frequent slides and ghost notes. The drum kit maintains a tight groove with a crisp, high-tuned snare and a dry kick drum. A brass section consisting of trumpet and tenor saxophone provides staccato rhythmic stabs and unison melodic flourishes. A Hammond B3 organ with a slow Leslie speaker effect fills the harmonic space with sustained chords and occasional percussive glissandos. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E Major. The mix uses a dry, 1970s-style production with minimal reverb and clear instrument separation.

[Instrumental]
